positions.name: MandateByDefinition
positions.frame: how does authority convert a directive into a self-evident rule — by fiat or by aphoristic equivalence?
positions.why: src-2 issues the monthly rollback-rehearsal cadence by declarative fiat; src-3 crystallizes the rationale into a matched-opposition maxim equating an unrehearsed rollback with a nonexistent one. Together they perform a mandate that enters as definition rather than proposal — the directive commands and the maxim makes it self-evident, the same authority-ranking move across both expressions.

positions.name: RecordRatifiesDirective
positions.frame: how does the record ratify a directive as settled operational fact?
positions.why: src-4 and src-5 transcribe the directive's cadence and ownership into structured metadata fields, performing ratification of the authority's allocation as settled fact rather than arguing for it — flat instrumental register matching the document's baseline, both enacting the same authority-ranking ratification.
